title: Exact ghost endpoints remove O(1) scaled-energy bias

statement.quantifiers: Fixed J,tau>0,kappa>2J pi²/3, lambda=lambda_*(kappa); smooth nonzero zero-energy Dirichlet minimizer theta with rho=sin²(theta/2); S=L-1 physical sites, BOTH endpoint fields.
statement.assertion: For product theta_i=theta(i/L) with ghost theta_0=theta_L=0, endpoint killing fields exactly complete missing bonds. <Hcrit>=J sum_(i=0)^(L-1)[1-cos Delta theta_i], <W>=sum rho_i²-(1/2)sum(Delta rho_i)². <B_L>=L E(theta)+O(C_theta/L). Bounded shifts kappa+zeta_L/L,lambda+eta_L/L change trial energy to -zeta_L int rho²-eta_L int rho+o(1).
assumptions: Hcrit=J sum interior(I-sigma dot sigma)+J(I-Z1)+J(I-ZS); A_L=L² Hcrit, B_L=A_L-kappa W-lambda N.
Smooth theta and rho have zero endpoint values; continuum minimizer energy zero.
Acquiring/certifying lambda_* and minimizer is separate from analytic existence.

inputs: Explicit lattice/continuum model with fixed parameters and analytic minimizer.
outputs: O(1/L) scaled trial bias and sufficient bounded-detuning robustness.
interface.precision: O(1/L) additive kappa/lambda precision is sufficient, not universally necessary; O(log L) bits plus threshold acquisition.
costs: 2^(L-1) Hilbert dimension and actual endpoints retained.
No efficient threshold solver, Gibbs sampler or preparation algorithm.

proof_mechanism: Complete endpoints exactly as ghost bonds.
Cell-mean Poincare controls kinetic quadrature; Taylor quartic remainder; trapezoid Peano error and contact square-difference identity.
Retain bias before moving parameters with L; combine with LA007 for entropy gain.
obstructions: Dropping either endpoint changes model and can restore hidden O(1) scaled bias.
O(1/L) robust window is only sufficient; shifts a logL/L need separate analysis.
No sharp finite-size width or exact coexistence weights.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Audit endpoint terms and high-order quadrature before using a leading continuum energy at coexistence.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
